column1: # Regular Gheg forms of standard verbs, found in the word counts of MaCoCu, HPLT v2 and Albanian Wikipedia (each used at least 10 times).
# -ue / -ye are the Gheg participle and infinitive (me punue = standard punuar, me thye = thyer), -uem and -un the Gheg participle
# adjectives (i punuem = i punuar, i lidhun = i lidhur). Forms that are also English words, standard accusatives (blogun) and

# Also literary Gheg spellings with nasal vowels (gjâ, kâmbë, vênd), checked one by one, and native words with Gheg ue for standard ua (grue, muej, ruej). Forms with another Gheg meaning (tutun "tobacco") are left out. Columns: form, dialect, word class, gender, standard word, English, page, note
